text: A bomb threat closed a large airport, so many aircraft were diverted to a smaller airport, about an hour away. Because of the large number of diverted aircraft, the taxiways at the smaller airport were blocked. As a result, planes had to taxi onto a single active runway, taxi to the opposite end, turn around and then take off. Why did aircraft have to use the active runway as a taxiway?
